result = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'pytest', 'test_semver.py', '--override-ini=addopts=', '-v'], capture_output=True, text=True)
# Count passed/failed

    if 'passed' in line or 'failed' in line or 'error' in line:
        print(line)
print(f"Return code: {result.returncode}")
